title: The Diggers
summary: The Redhand you drove out of the Old Barrows went back to Wickham Keep, under a Captain Garrow. Osric Hale has heard they are digging under its cellars. Bandits don't dig, so somebody must be paying them to.

steps.journal: Go to Wickham Keep, on the Wickham road north of the crossroads, and go down to its third floor, the Old Cellars, where the digging is.
Captain Garrow holds the last hall of the Old Cellars. Defeat him; his men come when he shouts.

ready: Go back to Osric Hale at the Watch post by Thornwick's well. Garrow kept a ledger; Osric will want it.
done: You defeated Captain Garrow in Wickham Keep. His ledger says robed strangers paid him to dig at the Sunken Chapel.
